checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-eval.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" eval --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao eval [command]' "$tmp/help"; for child in baseline baseline-audit bench chaos cleanup compare coverage outcomes run scenario scenario-ab scenario-moat scorecard session-outcome suite task; do grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]+$child([[:space:]]|$)" "$tmp/help"; done; "$tmp/ao" eval run --help >"$tmp/run-help"; for flag in baseline baseline-mode context-mode delta-out out run-id runtime; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/run-help"; done; set +e; "$tmp/ao" eval run >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; grep -Fq 'accepts 1 arg(s), received 0' "$tmp/err"

tracker_selection.reason: The eval family does not select a repository issue tracker.
